en: Black‑and‑white view of a late‑19th‑century spa‑town street with grand historicist buildings, likely hotels or sanatoria, on a gentle hillside. In the foreground is a landscaped park with a classical marble statue on a pedestal and flower beds. A woman in a long dress and hat carries a parasol while walking along the path, and an early horse‑drawn or motor carriage is on the unpaved road. The largest corner building has a mansard roof and bears the name "RUDOLFSHOF" near the top facade. Behind the buildings rise wooded hills.
